title: River Development Agent Production Implementation Execution Path Reconciliation
objective: Reconcile the legacy production implementation execution path with the canonical governed execution-package architecture by retiring repository-mutating apply behavior from implementRiverDevPlan, preserving its non-mutating dry-run compatibility, and leaving governed apply execution exclusively to the existing execution-package lifecycle and authoritative package executor.

architecture.authoritativeMutationBoundary: The existing package executor reached through the governed execution-package lifecycle remains the single authoritative production repository-mutation boundary.
architecture.legacyBoundary: implementRiverDevPlan remains only as a manifest-based compatibility boundary for non-mutating dry-run evaluation.
architecture.legacyApply: implementRiverDevPlan must fail closed for apply and direct callers to the governed execution-package lifecycle rather than reconstructing missing proposal, verification, package, persistence, or authorization state.
architecture.dryRunCompatibility: Legacy dry-run may continue loading the implementation manifest and invoking the existing runner explicitly in dry-run mode because that path is non-mutating and non-authorizing.
architecture.artifactIntegrity: The manifest-only legacy API does not possess the proposal and verification artifact paths required by the canonical lifecycle, so DEV-333 must not invent, derive, or reconstruct those artifacts.
architecture.authorityIntegrity: Legacy DEV-323/DEV-324 authority plumbing is removed from implementRiverDevPlan rather than adapted into a second apply path. Apply intent alone never authorizes execution.
architecture.canonicalApply: Authorized repository-mutating implementation remains available only through the existing governed execution-package lifecycle, which owns package creation, persistence, loading, composition, admission, authorization provenance, and package execution.
architecture.runnerBoundary: The package executor remains the only production boundary permitted to invoke the runner in a potentially mutating mode. implementRiverDevPlan may invoke the runner only with the literal dry-run mode.
architecture.noNewEngine: DEV-333 introduces no new execution engine, package executor, runner abstraction, authorization mechanism, artifact reconstruction, or persistence path.
architecture.scope: The demonstrated implementation scope is implement.ts plus implement.test.ts. Existing canonical lifecycle modules remain unchanged.
architecture.push: No push is performed as part of DEV-333.

invariants: Exactly one authoritative production repository-mutation boundary remains: the existing package executor reached through the governed execution-package lifecycle.
implementRiverDevPlan cannot perform repository-mutating apply execution.
implementRiverDevPlan may retain runner invocation only when the effective mode is explicitly dry-run.
Legacy apply fails closed instead of manufacturing or reconstructing proposal, verification, package, persistence, admission, or authorization state.
Apply intent alone cannot create or broaden authorization.
The existing canonical execution-package lifecycle and package executor remain unchanged and authoritative.
Historical DEV-323/DEV-324 modules may remain in the repository but no longer form a competing apply path through implementRiverDevPlan.
No repository mutation occurs through the legacy implementation command path.
acceptanceCriteria: implementRiverDevPlan rejects apply and identifies the governed execution-package lifecycle as the required production path.
implementRiverDevPlan no longer accepts or consumes the historical productionExecutionAuthority argument.
The legacy implementation command contains no potentially mutating runner.execute invocation.
The package executor remains the existing authoritative potentially mutating runner invocation boundary.
Obsolete DEV-323 authority fixtures and direct-apply success expectations are removed from implement.test.ts.
Focused implement tests prove dry-run remains non-mutating and legacy apply fails closed before repository writes.
Full River Development Agent regression passes before implementation commit.
Specification is committed separately before implementation and tests.
